topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I was so excited for the surprise, counting the days, imagining everyone's faces as they shouted, "Surprise!" When I found out it was called off, I was a bit disappointed, but I reminded myself, it was the thought that counts. I called a few friends to catch up, and we ended up chatting for hours, sharing laughs and good memories. It wasn't a party, but it was just as special, maybe even more so. It’s the people who matter most, not the plans. We’re already talking about new ways to get together, and I can’t wait.
